I am excited about your enthusiasm for expanding your __________ with AI by registering for our AI summer program. Thanks to your interest, more participants enrolled in our program than we expected. The program was supposed to be held in classroom 502 in the Ranark building, but it will be changed to classroom 103 in the Whitewood building. Thank you for your understanding. I am looking forward to meeting you all.
